description: This file defines the 'OperationBuilder' interface in the TensorFlow Java API, providing methods for constructing and configuring TensorFlow operations programmatically.

classes.name: OperationBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building TensorFlow operations with chainable configuration methods.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the configured Operation object.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds a single Output as an input to the operation being built.

methods.name: addInputList
methods.description: Adds a list of Outputs as inputs to the operation being built.

methods.name: addControlInput
methods.description: Adds a control dependency operation that must execute before this operation.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Specifies the device where the operation should run.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Overloaded methods for setting different types of attributes (String, byte[], long, float, boolean, DataType, Tensor, Shape) for the operation.
